speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help narrow down the cause of your symptoms, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the night sweats and weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Have you noticed any pain in your abdomen that is not related to meals, and do you have any fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for mentioning the neck swelling. Do you have any history of tuberculosis exposure or recent travel to areas where TB is common? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or any blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will perform a physical examination to check for hepatosplenomegaly and other lymphadenopathy. REQUEST TEST: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis

Abdominal examination reveals slight distension, dullness in the left lower quadrant, and splenomegaly without rebound tenderness. Blood work shows elevated WBC, slightly decreased hemoglobin, normal platelets, and elevated Lactate Dehydrogenase. Cervical lymph node biopsy shows lymphocytes with a high proliferative index staining positive for CD20.

text: RESULTS: CT Scan findings indicate massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes. speaker: Doctor
text:
The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index, combined with your B symptoms and widespread lymphadenopathy, strongly indicate a B-cell lymphoma. Given the aggressive nature suggested by the high proliferative index and LDH levels, this is most consistent with Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL).

DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
